items.title: Netanyahu rival condemns ‘Jewish terrorism’ after settler attacks on Palestinian villages

sentences.en: Netanyahu rival condemns ‘Jewish terrorism’ after settler attacks on Palestinian villages.
sentences.zh: 在定居者袭击巴勒斯坦村庄后，内塔尼亚胡的对手谴责“犹太恐怖主义”。

sentences.en: Dozens of militant Israeli settlers raided communities on Saturday night, setting fire to vehicles and several homes Arson attacks by militant Israeli settlers on Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank have caused a political row in Israel, drawing condemnation from Gadi Eisenkot, the opposition leader, who described them as “Jewish terrorism”.
sentences.zh: 数十名以色列激进定居者于周六晚袭击了多个社区，焚烧车辆和多处房屋。以色列激进定居者对被占领的约旦河西岸巴勒斯坦村庄的纵火袭击在以色列引发了政治争论，并招致反对党领袖加迪·艾森科特（Gadi Eisenkot）的谴责，他将这些袭击称为“犹太恐怖主义”。

sentences.en: Dozens of settlers raided Palestinian communities overnight on Saturday, setting fire to about a dozen vehicles and several homes and scrawling racist graffiti.
sentences.zh: 周六夜间，数十名定居者袭击了巴勒斯坦社区，纵火焚烧了约十二辆汽车和多处房屋，并涂写了种族主义涂鸦。

sentences.en: At least four communities were attacked.
sentences.zh: 至少有四个社区遭到袭击。

sentences.en: Israeli police said they had launched an investigation with forensic teams.
sentences.zh: 以色列警方表示，他们已与法医团队联手展开调查。

sentences.en: Continue reading..

items.title: South Korean minister quits after AI cheating scandal engulfs university exams

sentences.en: South Korean minister quits after AI cheating scandal engulfs university exams.
sentences.zh: 在人工智能作弊丑闻席卷大学考试后，韩国部长辞职。

sentences.en: Choi Kyo-jin says he ‘failed to prepare adequately’ for entrance exams following last-minute scramble to tighten measures South Korea’s education minister has resigned after an AI-assisted cheating scandal that erupted in the lead-up to key university entrance exams last week.
sentences.zh: 崔京珍表示，在最后一刻匆忙收紧措施后，他“未能为入学考试做好充分准备”。上周，在关键大学入学考试前夕爆发了一起人工智能辅助作弊丑闻，韩国教育部长因此辞职。

sentences.en: The country has been gripped by fears of AI-assisted exam cheating since last Sunday, when the top scorer in a national tax accountancy exam confessed to using a miniature camera and smartphone to achieve a near-perfect score, just four days before the crucial university entrance exam, known as the suneung .
sentences.zh: 自上周日以来，该国一直笼罩在对人工智能辅助考试作弊的恐惧之中。当时，在全国税务会计师考试中获得最高分的一名考生坦承，他使用了微型摄像头和智能手机来取得近乎满分的好成绩，而就在四天后，即将迎来被称为“高考”的至关重要的大学入学考试。

items.title: COP31 ends without climate pact as UN chief warns there is ‘no ambiguity in the science’

sentences.en: COP31 ends without climate pact as UN chief warns there is ‘no ambiguity in the science’.
sentences.zh: COP31会议在没有达成气候协议的情况下结束，联合国秘书长警告称“科学毫无含糊之处”。

sentences.en: COP31 ended on Sunday without a climate pact after negotiators failed to overcome divisions over fossil fuels, bringing two weeks of talks and two days of overtime to a close that UN Secretary-General António Guterres described as a “deeply disappointing” setback.
sentences.zh: COP31于周日结束，但由于谈判代表未能克服在化石燃料问题上的分歧，未能达成气候协议，为期两周的谈判和两天的加时谈判就此落下帷幕。联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯（António Guterres）将此形容为“令人深感失望”的挫折。

items.title: ‘I had a better life in Iran’: Afghan women forced home struggle to rebuild

sentences.en: ‘I had a better life in Iran’: Afghan women forced home struggle to rebuild.
sentences.zh: “我在伊朗的生活更好”：被迫返回家园的阿富汗女性正艰难地重建生活。

sentences.en: For five years, Zahra cared for an elderly woman in Iran and earned enough to get by.
sentences.zh: 五年里，扎赫拉在伊朗照顾一位老太太，赚取的收入足以维持生计。

sentences.en: Now back in Herat, western Afghanistan, the 28-year-old trained midwife is unemployed.
sentences.zh: 如今，这位28岁的受过培训的助产士回到了阿富汗西部的赫拉特，但处于失业状态。

sentences.en: She lives with her parents and siblings, apart from her six-year-old son, who lives with her ex-husband.
sentences.zh: 她与父母和兄弟姐妹同住，但她的六岁儿子与前夫同住。

items.title: UK-EU food deal hailed by British firms: ‘We’re pretty aligned anyway’

sentences.en: UK-EU food deal hailed by British firms: ‘We’re pretty aligned anyway’.
sentences.zh: 英国企业对英欧食品协议表示欢迎：“无论如何，我们都非常一致。”

sentences.en: Exporters welcome end in sight for Brexit checks – but are frustrated that implementation will take so long British producers have broadly welcomed the UK’s deal with the EU, designed to remove the vast majority of physical checks on food, plants and animal products.
sentences.zh: 出口商对脱欧检查即将结束表示欢迎，但对实施过程耗时过长感到沮丧。英国生产商普遍对英国与欧盟达成的协议表示欢迎，该协议旨在取消对食品、植物和动物产品的大部分实物检查。

sentences.en: The sanitary and phytosanitary (SPS) deal is expected to benefit Britain’s food exporters and will enable UK delicatessens and other small retailers to import European cheese and wine again, something that became economically unviable because of costly Brexit checks.
sentences.zh: 预计卫生与植物检疫（SPS）协议将使英国的食品出口商受益，并将使英国的熟食店和其他小型零售商能够再次进口欧洲奶酪和葡萄酒，由于英国脱欧检查成本高昂，这在经济上已不再可行。

sentences.zh: 还有时间报名！

sentences.en: He expected a small-business loan.
sentences.zh: 他希望获得一笔小企业贷款。

sentences.en: He got a 7-year nightmare.
sentences.zh: 他经历了7年的噩梦。

sentences.en: America's fastest-growing source of funding for small businesses is also one of the least regulated.
sentences.zh: 美国小企业发展最快的资金来源也是监管最少的资金来源之一。

sentences.en: One man has waged a long, lonely fight to recoup its punishing cost.
sentences.zh: 一位男士为弥补其高昂的代价，展开了一场漫长而孤独的斗争。

sentences.zh: 崔教振承认，在高考期间为阻止人工智能辅助作弊而采取的临时措施造成了混乱。

items.title: Bank of England directors illegally profited from post-abolition enslavement in Cuba

sentences.en: Bank of England directors illegally profited from post-abolition enslavement in Cuba.
sentences.zh: 英格兰银行的董事从古巴废奴后的奴役中非法获利。

sentences.en: New research finds that the British-led Cobre Mining Company helped industrialise Manchester via copper deposits and enslaved African people • Slave-trade wealth was embedded in Britain’s financial system, research finds British businesses run by long-serving directors of the Bank of England profited from “brutal” enslavement in Cuba for decades after slavery’s abolition in the British empire, according to research.
sentences.zh: 一项新研究发现，由英国人领导的Cobre矿业公司通过铜矿藏和奴役非洲人帮助曼彻斯特实现了工业化•研究发现，奴隶贸易的财富被嵌入到英国的金融体系中。研究表明，在英国帝国废除奴隶制后的几十年里，由英格兰银行长期任职的董事经营的英国企业从古巴的“残酷”奴役中获利。

sentences.en: Men and boys were enslaved in prison conditions at the El Cobre copper ore mine near Santiago de Cuba, which supplied British firms during the Industrial Revolution, the historian Chris Evans has found.
sentences.zh: 历史学家克里斯·埃文斯（Chris Evans）发现，在古巴圣地亚哥附近的埃尔科布雷（El Cobre）铜矿，男子和男孩被奴役在监狱般的条件下。该矿在工业革命期间曾为英国公司提供矿石。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Fire at confectionery factory in Indonesia leaves at least three dead and dozens missing

sentences.en: Fire at confectionery factory in Indonesia leaves at least three dead and dozens missing.
sentences.zh: 印度尼西亚糖果厂发生火灾，造成至少3人死亡，数十人失踪。

sentences.en: Relatives of the missing victims flocked to the factory’s entrance, seeking updates about their loved ones A fire at a confectionery factory west of Jakarta has killed three people with 36 remaining missing, an Indonesian rescue official says.
sentences.zh: 失踪人员的亲属涌向工厂入口，希望了解亲人的最新消息。印尼救援官员表示，雅加达西部一家糖果厂发生火灾，造成3人死亡，36人失踪。

sentences.en: Drone footage showed large parts of the factory destroyed, with the roof collapsed in places and smoke still rising from the complex.
sentences.zh: 无人机拍摄的画面显示，工厂的大部分被摧毁，屋顶多处坍塌，烟雾仍从厂区升起。

sentences.en: Photos and videos shared by rescuers show officers entering the charred building in search of the missing victims on Sunday, with small fires still burning in some spots.
sentences.zh: 救援人员分享的照片和视频显示，周日，消防员进入被烧焦的大楼搜寻失踪的受害者，大楼的一些地方仍有小火在燃烧。

items.title: ‘Serious error of judgment’: outrage over military AI event at Berlin arts complex

sentences.en: ‘Serious error of judgment’: outrage over military AI event at Berlin arts complex.
sentences.zh: “严重的判断失误”：柏林艺术园区举办的军事人工智能活动引发众怒。

sentences.en: Kraftwerk Berlin, part of same development as techno club Tresor, transformed into ‘war room’ for arms firm event With their cavernous post-industrial venues, teeth-grinding four-by-four beats and bouncers that look like Blade Runner extras, Berlin’s nightclubs trade on a reputation for bleakness.
sentences.zh: Kraftwerk Berlin与知名夜店Tresor同属一个开发项目，现已改造成武器公司活动的“战情室”。柏林的夜店以阴郁著称，它们拥有宽敞的后工业时代场馆、令人牙痒的四拍节拍，以及看起来像《银翼杀手》中龙套的保镖。

sentences.en: A recent event at one of the city’s most legendary clubland institutions, however, has proven too dystopian even for seasoned techno-heads.
sentences.zh: 然而，最近在市内一家最具传奇色彩的俱乐部举办的一场活动，即使对于经验丰富的电音爱好者来说，也显得过于反乌托邦了。

sentences.en: On 11 November, the Kraftwerk Berlin arts complex had its central hall transformed into what visitors described as something resembling a war room, with maps and aerial footage projected on to concrete walls, drones hanging from the ceiling, and guards in flak jackets patrolling the premises with sniffer dogs.
sentences.zh: 11月11日，柏林Kraftwerk艺术中心的中央大厅被改造成参观者所说的类似战情室的地方，混凝土墙上投影着地图和航拍影像，天花板上悬挂着无人机，身穿防弹背心的警卫带着警犬在场馆内巡逻。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Europe is entering a ‘supercycle’ of national elections. Their outcomes could shake the EU’s foundations

sentences.en: Europe is entering a ‘supercycle’ of national elections.
sentences.zh: 欧洲正在进入一个国家选举的“超级周期”。

sentences.en: Their outcomes could shake the EU’s foundations.
sentences.zh: 选举结果可能会动摇欧盟的根基。

sentences.en: As nationalist, Eurosceptic parties surge in four of the bloc’s biggest member states, the coming year’s polls could test its resilience like never before In late 1998, Tony Blair was prime minister of Britain, Lionel Jospin was prime minister of France, and Gerhard Schröder had just been elected chancellor of Germany.
sentences.zh: 随着民族主义和疑欧派政党在欧盟四个最大成员国中崛起，明年的选举可能会前所未有地考验欧盟的韧性。1998年末，托尼·布莱尔是英国首相，利昂内尔·若斯潘是法国总理，格哈德·施罗德刚刚当选德国总理。

sentences.en: The EU had 15 member states and pro-European, centre-left parties were in power – either alone or in coalitions – in all but two of them.
sentences.zh: 欧盟当时有15个成员国，除两个国家外，其余所有国家均由亲欧派的中左翼政党执政，这些政党有的单独执政，有的则组成联合政府。

sentences.en: Brisk economic growth was lifting living standards.
sentences.zh: 蓬勃的经济增长正在提高生活水平。

sentences.en: Eastward enlargement was under way.
sentences.zh: 向东扩张正在进行中。

sentences.en: In Washington, Bill Clinton was pursuing the same brand of “third way” centrism as a middle path between free-market capitalism and traditional socialism.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿，比尔·克林顿也在推行同样的“第三条道路”中间主义，将其作为自由市场资本主义和传统社会主义之间的中间道路。

sentences.en: The EU felt like it had the tide of history behind it.
sentences.zh: 欧盟感到历史的潮流站在自己这一边。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Alleged Mexican drug cartel boss ‘El Chapo Isidro’ arrested in special forces raid

sentences.en: Alleged Mexican drug cartel boss ‘El Chapo Isidro’ arrested in special forces raid.
sentences.zh: 据称墨西哥贩毒集团头目“矮子伊西德罗”在特种部队的突袭中被捕。

sentences.en: Fausto Isidro Meza Flores was one of FBI’s most wanted fugitives and evaded capture for more than a decade The Mexican military captured one of the FBI’s 10 most wanted fugitives during a special forces raid in the Mexican state of Sinaloa on Friday night.
sentences.zh: 福斯托·伊西德罗·梅萨·弗洛雷斯是联邦调查局（FBI）通缉的头号逃犯之一，他逃亡了十多年。周五晚，墨西哥军方在墨西哥锡那罗亚州的一次特种部队突袭行动中抓获了联邦调查局通缉的十大逃犯之一。

sentences.en: Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as “El Chapo Isidro”, was arrested along with two other alleged leaders of his gang after a gun battle that triggered widespread panic in the city of Guasave.
sentences.zh: Fausto Isidro Meza Flores，绰号“El Chapo Isidro”，在一次引发瓜萨维市大范围恐慌的枪战后，与该团伙的另外两名疑似头目一同被捕。
